scientific_integrity: Original KD45 disagreement semantics, general generated-neighborhood theorems, basic three-state counting and Boolean complement symmetry are credited. The finite exact observational profile and query classification are assessed within inspected sources; the full Chen–Pan (2018) paper was not available and an equivalent generic active-learning theorem cannot be ruled out.
scientific_limitations: Fixed labelled finite worlds and named agents, serial/transitive/Euclidean relations, one-step atomic valuation queries, complete noiseless all-world outputs; only the induced operator, not individual agent relations, is reconstructed. Two-agent quotient is pointed; no multi-agent quotient count. No independent audit.
title: Exact Observability and Sharp Query Complexity of Finite KD45 Disagreement
